text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
One day, during a casual chat with Inari
One...

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
Tellin' lies just isn't my strong suit. Even
if I try to
keep a straight face, people
can tell I'm lyin' right
away.

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
It's a rare necessity anyhow. Us Edo folk
prefer to
keep it honest.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: Sorry, but could you help me? Please!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text: Oh, wazzup, Creek? You okay?

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
Actually, I'm being followed, and the
person
chasing me is going to catch up
any second now!
Do you think I could
hide here for a short while?

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
Ya seem pretty relaxed for someone
bein' chased.
Am I missin' somethin'?

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
Whatever the case, I'm sure you're not
the bad
guy in this. We gotta stick
together in times of
trouble, eh?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Super Creek hurries to take refuge in a
locker.

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
Excuse me, Inari! I have an urgent
request!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
Hey, Bamboo. What's got ya all worked
up?

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: I'm chasing Creek! I'm putting out a warrant for her capture after she went on an indiscriminate pampering spree!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text: H-huh? She did what?!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
(Rattin' Creek out will make me a liar for
sayin'
she could trust me. But if I'm
gonna protect her, I
gotta lie all the
same... Gahhh...)

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
I'm pretty sure she ran this way. You
didn't
happen to see her, did you, Inari?

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text: Ah?! W-well!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: Hm, did you see her?! Is she here?!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text: N-nah! I...

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
...Nope, no clue where she could've
scurried off
to. Sorry!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
Is that so? Well, if you say she hasn't
come here, I
believe you! Oh, but wait,
perhaps she crept in
here without you
realizing it?

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
Ya think? Go ahead and take a look
around then!
You're good to search
anywhere besides that
locker!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: Locker? Is there something in there?

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
Ah! W-well, ya see... That locker there
is...
haunted! That's right! It's got some
creepy
creature livin' inside!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
(Gragh! Lyin' to my cute underclassman...
what
the heck am I doin'? But I can't
break my promise
to Creek either! This
sucks!)

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Despite Inari One's clumsy lies, she
manages to
avoid exposing Super Creek.
Then, just when
Bamboo Memory is
about to give up her pursuit...

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
Ya satisfied, Bamboo? Whew... this is
more tirin'
than runnin'...

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
Thank you for your cooperation, Inari!
Well, I
should get going. See y—huh?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Bamboo Memory's gaze falls upon... a
rattle toy
seemingly dropped by Super
Creek!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
This rattle?! Isn't it one of Creek's seven
tools?

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
N-no, ya got it all wrong! That's not
Creek's...
it's... it's...

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text: It's mine!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
Truth is, I've been kinda tired lately.
And it... ya
know... it's just the thing to
help me relax... Uh...
Yeah!

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: Really?!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text: Ah.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: Why didn't you say something earlier?! Whenever you need to relax, come to me so I can help you!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
What're ya doin', Creek?! The jig is up
now! I
knew it, I'm no good at lyin'!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
What, ya mean tellin' more lies?! No
friggin' way! I
can't help but tell the
truth.
choice_data_list: さらに勢いが出せれば誤魔化せたかも
最後まで諦めずにいけばなんとか……

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
No wonder you started crying for
comfort. ♪
There, there!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
Sh-shut it! Ah, crap! I'll never tell
another lie
again!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
As Super Creek is finally taken away, she
shoots a
suspiciously longing gaze at
Inari One.

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
C'mon, the heck was I supposed to do?
Only a
real fast-talker coulda pulled
that off!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: That makes you guilty of the crime of preparing to practice deception! And considering your previous lie, as disciplinary committee chair, I can't let this slip!
choice_data_list: いっそ嘘の練習でもしてみるか？
いっそ嘘の練習でもしてみる？

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: Sigh... It's a real shame, Inari, but at least let me be the one to put the cuffs on you. All of you are under arrest!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
And so, the three of us are apprehended
and
escorted away.
